## 2600 - 2659

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02600">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2600 USPG - Ultrasonic path gain</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02600">

Ultrasonic path gain (USPG) exceptions are related to the limits defined for path gain check for ultrasonic data in the Ultrasonic 1 page in the Meter Editor Flowing Parameters Validations tab. The path gain check is available only for ultrasonic meters. Path gain data are displayed in the UFM Diagnostic tab in the Volume Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02601">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2601 USPG - Path 1a gain too low</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02601">

This exception is generated when the Path Gain 1a on a UFM Diagnostic record of a ultrasonic meter is less than the Min limit set in the Ultrasonic 1 validation in the Meter Editor. For example, the Min value for 1a is set to 200.000 but the value on the UFM Diagnostic record is 197.000.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02602">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02650">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2650 USPG - Path 2a gain is out of range as compared to path 1a</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02650">

This exception is generated when the Path Gain 2a for a ultrasonic meter varies from the Path Gain 1a by more than the Percent Difference limit set in the Ultrasonic 1 validation in the Meter Editor.

For example, in the Path Gain Check group box on the Ultrasonic 1 sub-tab of the Meter Editor, the Percent Difference is set to 10.00, and Check Path 2 is set to Yes. For a UFM Diagnostics record, the Path Gain 1a is 216 and Path Gain 2a is 179. The percent difference is abs(179/216 – 1) \* 100 = 17.1296 %. This exceeds the Percent Difference value of 10.00, so the exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02656">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2656 USPG - Path 5a gain is out of range as compared to path 1a</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02656">

This exception is generated when the Path Gain 5a for a ultrasonic meter varies from the Path Gain 1a by more than the Percent Difference limit set in the Ultrasonic 1 validation in the Meter Editor.

For example, in the Path Gain Check group box on the Ultrasonic 1 sub-tab of the Meter Editor, the Percent Difference is set to 10.00, and Check Path 5 is set to Yes. For a UFM Diagnostics record, the Path Gain 1a is 216 and Path Gain 5a is 179. The percent difference is abs(179/216 – 1) \* 100 = 17.1296 %. This exceeds the Percent Difference value of 10.00, so the exception is generated.

</div>
